shortDescription: The US will transfer $2.5 million recovered from a Maryland property tied to former Gambian dictator Yahya Jammeh to compensate eligible victims of his more than 22-year rule, according to Bloomberg.

children: The US will transfer $2.5 million recovered from a Maryland property tied to former Gambian dictator Yahya Jammeh to compensate eligible victims of his more than 22-year rule, according to Bloomberg.

title: US to Return $2.5 Million Seized From Property Linked to Ex-Gambian Dictator
